bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder May 7, 2018

Join master artist John Glass at a free demonstration this Saturday, May 12 from 2 to 4 PM at The Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists. John will illustrate the under painting technique he uses to start his oil paintings, with the subject a riverside spot.

The Art Gallery (source page unavailable) is located at 551 Main Street (Rte.28) in Harwich Port, (508) 432-1012. Free parking across the street at the Harwich Chamber of Commerce Visitors Information Center.

 

Posted in EDUCATION, MEET THE ARTIST, THE ART GALLERY, THE ART GALLERY ARTISTS, WHAT'S NEW
